scientific_conclusion: The fixed Stage-117 audit finds one coherent radial transition across all three wall-distance bands: phi exceeds psi on shell-1 radial nodes 0-2 and psi exceeds phi on nodes 3-9. The difference-profile cross-band cosine is at least 0.99906, the centroid-speed gap varies by only 5.67% relative to its mean, and total-variation distance remains 0.353-0.363. This is a positive localization/coherence result only. It does not establish why the reduced distributions separate this way, does not establish MUSCL instability causality, and does not validate or repair the nonconverged solver.
